brief:
An Israeli drone strike killed one Palestinian and wounded several others in northern Gaza on Wednesday evening, Shehab Wire reported. The attack struck the northern sector of the territory as the enclave continues to endure sustained aerial bombardment by Israeli forces.

Video and photographic documentation of the strike circulated through news outlets, capturing the aftermath of the drone operation. The incident marked another casualty in the ongoing military campaign affecting civilian areas across Gaza's northern regions.
